critical_code_review_comments: Execution pipeline is intentionally fail-closed: runner preflight always blocks at cost-ceiling gate even when configured; this is consistent with current NOT READY state and should remain explicit in UX copy.
Secret-safe validation route wrapper correctly prevents Pydantic input echo on 422 for credential forms; regression tests now cover this behavior.
Gateway dispatch correctly records missing provider cost as PENDING/UNKNOWN (not zero) and performs single-shot failure semantics (no retry).
